Container.Name: fieldwork
Container.Overview: Chess review and practice with bundled Stockfish and one persistent database. Everyone signs in with their own account; create the first administrator from the container console. Behind a reverse proxy you can change the Advanced View WebUI shortcut to its HTTPS address. Cloudflare and Compose are optional. Engine, human-model and review settings are in the app under Settings → Advanced → Server.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: LAN port for the app. Open WebUI follows this mapping automatically. Proxies forward HTTP to this host port.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Persistent games, accounts and progress. Keep when updating. Must be writable by UID 99 and GID 100, configured in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: Account support
Config.Description: Must stay true: the container always requires sign-in. The no-login workspace runs only from source, for development.

Config.Name: Public origin
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank: Fieldwork accepts the address people open it at. Set the exact browser address, e.g. https://chess.example.com, only if your reverse proxy rewrites the Host header. Restart after changing.

Config.Name: Secure session cookies
Config.Description: Keep true. Plain HTTP sign-in already works at the server's LAN address from devices on your network; public names and outside visitors need HTTPS. Set false only for local development.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy addresses
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy: the proxy address whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted, so sign-in rate limits apply per visitor instead of to everyone behind the proxy. Use the proxy container's address, or * on a private Docker network.

Config.Name: Human model device
Config.Description: cpu (default) runs Maia on the processor and downloads nothing extra. cuda runs it on an NVIDIA GPU: install the Nvidia Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters and set NVIDIA visible devices below. The first start with cuda downloads CUDA PyTorch (about 3 GB, 6.4 GB on disk) into App data/runtime; later starts reuse it.

Config.Name: NVIDIA visible devices
Config.Description: Only for Human model device cuda with --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters. Paste the GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page (GPU-...), or all. Leave blank for CPU.

Config.Name: NVIDIA driver capabilities
Config.Description: Only used with --runtime=nvidia. compute lets PyTorch run on the GPU; utility adds nvidia-smi. Normally leave as is.

Config.Name: Human model file
Config.Description: Persistent pinned Maia-3 79M checkpoint, approximately 316 MB. The setup command downloads and verifies it here. Kept outside the image and database; survives container updates.
